title: Graphic additive bases and graph flows
summary: The lattice-coset method of Alon, Bucić, and Davies gives real solutions with controlled coordinates. We combine it with integer rounding to prescribe outdegrees and flows from spanning-tree packing. For every integer $q\ge3$, $q$ edge-disjoint spanning trees suffice for every outdegree prescription modulo $q$ whose sum is compatible with the number of edges. The tree count is optimal even for simple graphs. A common interval theorem extends the argument to totally unimodular matrices; for graphs, its partition inequalities admit a sharp allowance of two.
